operating_model: single-developer; agent-panel lenses, not additional humans

required_lenses.focus: digest binding, lineage, correction and reproducibility
claim classification, assumptions, uncertainty and limitations
integrity, rollback, secrets, permissions and operational controls

execution_environments.purpose: clean checkout, immutable revision and artifact retention
reconstruct an archived packet without live endpoints

independence_criteria: Each lens receives the same exact revision and source or archive digest.
Each lens writes a separate content-addressed report before synthesis.
The orchestrator preserves dissent and cannot convert missing evidence into a pass.
Agent-panel agreement cannot create source authority, participant evidence or release approval.
A factual external operator or user workflow remains a separate required gate for beta, RC and stable-v1.
non_claims: This contract selects assessment lenses; it is not a factual participant report.
This contract does not establish publication, preservation acceptance, elapsed qualification or release authority.
